runtime.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 5 3550H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx

algorithm: CSL finite_action_minimax plus HiGHS ConvexPort linear QP MPC

execution.warm_start: none; fresh provider workspace for each QP solve

timing_scope: Each native process runs all policies in an alternating forward/reverse controller order. Decision timing includes planner problem setup and solver calls, not process startup, JSON output, independent replay, or rendering. Provider registration/setup and whole-process elapsed time are recorded separately.
deadline: 50 ms per decision; stop status and late-return fallback are retained; solver cancellation is cooperative
limiter_profile: not collected; no speedup or performance-winner claim
numeric_method: binary64; exact finite catalogues and independent source replay with tolerance checks; HiGHS residual tolerances retained per QP solve
scope: finite-action and continuous-control QP, four-step source-derived adaptation; not a reproduction of the continuous-action four-second RL task; finite disturbance histories only
